headline: Anthropic 发布常驻个人 agent Claude Duet，AI 安全漏洞成今日热议
bullets: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet，一个独立的常驻个人 agent，能主动发现并处理待办事项，目前在美国 Pro/Max 计划候补测试。
Vercel 提前为 Node.js 和 PHP 的高危漏洞部署防火墙缓解措施，builder 们讨论 AI 在发现和防御漏洞中的作用。
DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 接入 Vercel Token Pass，主打极低成本，适合跑子 agent。
Pigment 和 Legora 分别宣布 2.5 亿美元和 5.5 亿美元 E 轮融资。
多位 builder 强调企业需要「前沿团队」专门跟进模型变化，否则跟不上 AI 节奏。
sentiment: 整体偏兴奋但带焦虑：兴奋于 Claude Duet 这类主动型 agent 和新模型能力，焦虑于 AI 加速暴露的网络安全漏洞和跟不上节奏的压力。

posts.name: Aaron Levie
posts.text:
If you wanted to know all the jobs that AI will produce, look no further than cybersecurity. This is going to become one of the biggest investment areas for enterprises going forward. 

And even as the work becomes more agentic and autonomous you will need more talent to point the agents at the most critical work, review findings, patch systems, respond to incidents, and more. 

Lots of opportunity right now for the systems that protect data and enterprises, as well as the professionals that are deploying them and protecting organizations.

It’s going to only get more wild out there.

posts.name: Dan Shipper
posts.text:
BREAKING:

@AnthropicAI just launched Duet, its always-on personal agent. It’s the first personal agent I’d call a pro tool.

We’ve been testing it for two weeks. I’ve gone from mostly using ChatGPT to roughly 50/50 between ChatGPT and Claude—the most time I’ve spent with Anthropic in close to a year.

• It lives in its own app, separate from Claude, on iOS, Android, and the web. This makes it feel clean and easy to understand.
• It has channels for specific areas of your work and life rather than just a single chat
• It has a todo list so you never lose what you’re working on and you can always see statuses
• It allows you to easily write and edit documents, slides, and more all through the app.
• It’s not a chief of staff yet. It can see the Claude sessions on my computers but can’t direct them. Its email drafts are worse than dot’s, and voice is transcription only—you can’t have a spoken conversation with it.

My verdict: the vibes are good, and I’m opening Duet every day. It’s worth trying.

Check out our agent comparison page: https://t.co/fZyTorNK4p

Full Vibe Check coming soon on @every
posts.summaryZh: Dan Shipper 评测 Anthropic 新发布的常驻个人 agent Claude Duet，称其是首个够专业的个人 agent，有独立 app、频道和待办清单，但还不能指挥其他 Claude 会话。

posts.name: Aaron Levie
posts.text:
Cyber is going to be one of the most profound aspects of AI. We now have a tireless workforce that can hunt down, discover, patch, or attack any system and software ever created.

We will use agents to identify the long standing risks in existing systems and infrastructure. Attackers will use agents to accelerate the discovery of gaps in environments. We will equally use agents to defend attacks and discover anomalous patterns to better protect our data, and much more.

We’re entering a new cyber regime, and we’ll probably use 100X more tokens on this loop than we’re imagining right now, because we can scan every log, look at every line of code, look through traffic, and process data at a scale that wasn’t comprehensible before.

More than ever, enterprises are going to care deeply about how they manage their networks, systems, software, data, identity, devices, and more. Agents will largely become the solution to these challenges, but they will keep everyone up in the process.
posts.summaryZh: Levie 认为 AI 将带来全新的网络安全格局，攻防双方都会用 agent，token 消耗可能比现在想象的多 100 倍。

posts.name: Aditya Agarwal
posts.text:
I'm still grokking this...but it does feel like it just as fun to make stuff with AI as it is to "use" it.

My son watched Star Wars (EP IV) for ~3 hours...but then spent ~20 hours making games about what he had seen. 

But weirdly, he only played the games a little bit...he was more interested in just building the game.

As a programmer, I understand parts of this intuitively...the very act of programming is fun (most of the time). And I have always felt bad for people who couldn't experience that joy...

But maybe everyone will now get to experience that?
posts.summaryZh: Aditya Agarwal 观察到儿子看《星球大战》3 小时却花 20 小时做相关游戏，觉得用 AI 创作和用 AI 一样有趣，编程的快乐可能人人可得了。
